blocks.original_text:
- name: int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis
      description: Customer behavior profile per resolved customer with cross-platform engagement, lifecycle metrics, and segmentation
      grain: One row per source match key (marketo_lead_id, stripe_customer_id, zendesk_user_id) with non-null primary_email
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_customer360__source_matches
      - intermediate.int_customer360__marketo
      - intermediate.int_customer360__stripe
      - intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk
      business_logic: 'Build per-customer behavior and segmentation by: - Source inputs: - Marketo (intermediate.int_customer360__marketo) per lead_id - Stripe (intermediate.int_customer360__stripe) per customer_id - Zendesk (intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk) per user_id - Identity map (intermediate.int_customer360__source_matches) providing the cross-platform ID linkage - Per-platform metrics: - Marketo: - marketo_first_touch = created_at; marketo_last_activity = updated_at - marketo_engagement_score: - 0 if is_unsubscribed = true or is_email_invalid = true - else 3 if days between created_at and updated_at < 30 - else 2 if < 90 - else 1 - has_organization_data = 1 if organization_name_no_suffix not null and length > 3 else 0 - has_phone_contact = 1 if phone or mobile_phone present else 0 - address_completeness_score: - 3 if country_code, state_code, and city all present - 2 if country_code present and at least one of state_code or city present - 1 if only country_code present - 0 otherwise - Stripe: - stripe_first_transaction = created_at; stripe_last_activity = updated_at - stripe_engagement_score: - 0 if is_deleted = true - 1 if is_delinquent = true (and not deleted) - else 4 if days between created_at and updated_at < 30 - else 3 if < 90 - else 2 - payment_reliability_score: - 3 if is_delinquent = false and is_deleted = false - 1 if is_delinquent = true and is_deleted = false - 0 otherwise - billing_completeness_score: - 2 if customer_address_line_1 and customer_country_code present - 1 if only customer_country_code present - 0 otherwise - Zendesk: - zendesk_first_contact = created_at; zendesk_last_activity = updated_at - zendesk_engagement_score: - 0 if is_suspended = true or is_deleted = true - 1 if is_active = false - else 4 if days between created_at and updated_at < 30 - else 3 if < 90 - else 2 - org_relationship_strength: - 2 if organization_id and organization_name_no_suffix present - 1 if only organization_id present - 0 otherwise - Join and aggregate: - Left join per-platform metrics to source_matches on respective IDs - primary_email = coalesce(Marketo.email, Stripe.email, Zendesk.email); rows with NULL primary_email are excluded - email_domain and primary_organization use the same COALESCE order (Marketo, then Stripe, then Zendesk) - customer_first_touchpoint = the earliest of the three per-platform first-touch timestamps - customer_last_activity = the latest of the three per-platform last-activity timestamps - If any of the three timestamps is NULL, the earliest/latest result is NULL - marketo_engagement/stripe_engagement/zendesk_engagement = respective per-platform scores with NULL → 0 - composite_engagement_score = weighted average (weights: Marketo 0.3, Stripe 0.5, Zendesk 0.2), rounded to two decimals and stored with one decimal precision - in_marketo/in_stripe/in_zendesk = 1 if respective joined record exists, else 0 - organization_data_quality = coalesce(has_organization_data,0) + coalesce(billing_completeness_score,0) + coalesce(org_relationship_strength,0) - has_contact_phone = coalesce(has_phone_contact, 0) - address_data_quality = coalesce(address_completeness_score,0) + coalesce(billing_completeness_score,0) - marketing_to_sales_days = days between Marketo first touch and Stripe first transaction only if both present; else NULL - sales_to_support_days = days between Stripe first transaction and Zendesk first contact only if both present; else NULL - account_age_days = days between the earliest available first-touch and current_date; NULL if the earliest is NULL - customer_maturity (derived from the same earliest timestamp vs current_date): - ''New Customer'' if < 90 days - ''Growing Relationship'' if < 365 days - ''Established Customer'' if < 1095 days - ''Long-term Customer'' otherwise (including when the start date is NULL) - customer_journey_pattern based on platform presence, evaluated in this order: - ''Full Journey'' if all three present - ''Marketing to Sales'' if Marketo and Stripe - ''Sales to Support'' if Stripe and Zendesk - ''Marketing to Support'' if Marketo and Zendesk - ''Marketing Only'' if only Marketo - ''Sales Only'' if only Stripe - ''Support Only'' if only Zendesk - ''Unknown'' otherwise - payment_reliability = coalesce(Stripe.payment_reliability_score, 0) - Classification: - customer_segment (first match wins): - ''Champion'' if composite_engagement_score >= 3.5 and payment_reliability >= 2 - ''Loyal Customer'' if composite_engagement_score >= 3.0 and customer_journey_pattern = ''Full Journey'' - ''Potential Loyalist'' if composite_engagement_score >= 2.5 and payment_reliability >= 2 - ''New Customer'' if composite_engagement_score >= 2.0 and account_age_days < 90 - ''At Risk'' if composite_engagement_score >= 1.5 - ''Hibernating'' if composite_engagement_score > 0 - ''Lost'' otherwise - churn_risk_level: - ''High Risk'' if payment_reliability = 0 or composite_engagement_score < 1 - ''Medium Risk'' if composite_engagement_score < 2 and account_age_days > 365 - ''Medium Risk'' if customer_last_activity is more than 90 days ago - ''Low Risk'' otherwise (including when comparisons evaluate to NULL) - recommended_action based on customer_segment: - ''Upsell/Cross-sell'' for ''Champion'' or ''Loyal Customer'' - ''Engagement Campaign'' for ''Potential Loyalist'' - ''Onboarding Focus'' for ''New Customer'' - ''Win-back Campaign'' for ''At Risk'' - ''Reactivation Campaign'' for ''Hibernating'' - ''Recovery Campaign'' otherwise - Output filter and ordering: - Keep only rows where primary_email is not NULL - Order rows by composite_engagement_score descending, then account_age_days descending'
      columns:
      - name: marketo_lead_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Marketo lead identifier from source_matches; nullable when no Marketo mapping exists
      - name: stripe_customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Stripe customer identifier from source_matches; nullable when no Stripe mapping exists
      - name: zendesk_user_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Zendesk user identifier from source_matches; nullable when no Zendesk mapping exists
      - name: primary_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary email chosen by Marketo then Stripe then Zendesk; not null due to final filter; casing and spacing preserved
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: email_domain
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Email domain chosen by the same precedence as primary_email; NULL if all source domains are NULL; formatting preserved
      - name: primary_organization
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Organization chosen by precedence Marketo, then Stripe, then Zendesk; NULL if all are NULL
      - name: customer_first_touchpoint
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest timestamp across the three platform first-touch timestamps; NULL if any input is NULL
      - name: customer_last_activity
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Latest timestamp across the three platform last-activity timestamps; NULL if any input is NULL
      - name: marketo_engagement
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Marketo engagement score per rules in business_logic (0/1/2/3); NULL Marketo row yields 0
      - name: stripe_engagement
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Stripe engagement score per rules in business_logic (0/1/2/3/4); NULL Stripe row yields 0
      - name: zendesk_engagement
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Zendesk engagement score per rules in business_logic (0/1/2/3/4); NULL Zendesk row yields 0
      - name: composite_engagement_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(14,1)
        description: Weighted average of platform scores (weights 0.3, 0.5, 0.2), rounded to two decimals then stored with one decimal; missing scores treated as 0; range 0.0–3.7
      - name: in_marketo
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Platform presence flag derived from join on Marketo (1 if joined row exists, else 0); values strictly 0 or 1
      - name: in_stripe
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Platform presence flag derived from join on Stripe (1 if joined row exists, else 0); values strictly 0 or 1
      - name: in_zendesk
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Platform presence flag derived from join on Zendesk (1 if joined row exists, else 0); values strictly 0 or 1
      - name: organization_data_quality
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Aggregate org data score = has_organization_data(0/1) + billing_completeness_score(0/1/2) + org_relationship_strength(0/1/2); NULL components treated as 0; range 0–5
      - name: has_contact_phone
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 1 if Marketo has phone or mobile_phone, else 0; NULL treated as 0; values strictly 0 or 1
      - name: address_data_quality
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Address/billing completeness = Marketo.address_completeness_score(0–3) + Stripe.billing_completeness_score(0–2); NULL components treated as 0; range 0–5
      - name: marketing_to_sales_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days from Marketo first touch to Stripe first transaction; NULL unless both timestamps are non-null; may be negative or positive
      - name: sales_to_support_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days from Stripe first transaction to Zendesk first contact; NULL unless both timestamps are non-null; may be negative or positive
      - name: account_age_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days from the earliest first-touch timestamp to current_date; NULL if the earliest is NULL; computed at execution time
      - name: customer_maturity
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Lifecycle label based on days since earliest touch: New Customer (<90), Growing Relationship (<365), Established Customer (<1095), else Long-term Customer; NULL start yields Long-term Customer'
      - name: customer_journey_pattern
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Journey coverage across platforms with precedence: Full Journey; Marketing to Sales; Sales to Support; Marketing to Support; Marketing Only; Sales Only; Support Only; else Unknown'
      - name: payment_reliability
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Stripe-derived reliability score: 3 (not delinquent and not deleted), 1 (delinquent and not deleted), 0 otherwise; NULL Stripe row yields 0'
      - name: customer_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Segment assigned by ordered rules: Champion; Loyal Customer; Potential Loyalist; New Customer; At Risk; Hibernating; else Lost'
      - name: churn_risk_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Risk level by ordered rules: High if payment_reliability=0 or composite<1; Medium if composite<2 and age>365; Medium if last activity >90 days ago; else Low'
      - name: recommended_action
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Next best action mapped from customer_segment: Upsell/Cross-sell; Engagement Campaign; Onboarding Focus; Win-back Campaign; Reactivation Campaign; else Recovery Campaign'

output.equality_policy: exact CAST AS VARCHAR per row; no trim/case/numeric/date normalization; both NULL ignored; at least one nonnull equal row; one-sided NULL differs

alternatives.expression_sql: CASE WHEN m_created IS NULL OR s_created IS NULL OR z_created IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE LEAST(m_created, s_created, z_created) END
CASE WHEN m_updated IS NULL OR s_updated IS NULL OR z_updated IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE GREATEST(m_updated, s_updated, z_updated) END
CASE WHEN NOT m_email IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
CASE WHEN NOT s_email IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
CASE WHEN NOT z_email IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
CAST(CASE WHEN NOT m_created IS NULL AND NOT s_created IS NULL THEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', m_created, s_created) END AS BIGINT)
CAST(CASE WHEN NOT s_created IS NULL AND NOT z_created IS NULL THEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', s_created, z_created) END AS BIGINT)
CASE WHEN age_days < 90 THEN 'New Customer' WHEN age_days < 365 THEN 'Growing Relationship' WHEN age_days < 1095 THEN 'Established Customer' ELSE 'Long-term Customer' END

CASE WHEN NOT m_email IS NULL AND NOT s_email IS NULL AND NOT z_email IS NULL THEN 'Full Journey' WHEN NOT m_email IS NULL AND NOT s_email IS NULL THEN 'Marketing to Sales' WHEN NOT s_email IS NULL AND NOT z_email IS NULL THEN 'Sales to Support' WHEN NOT m_email IS NULL AND NOT z_email IS NULL THEN 'Marketing to Support' WHEN NOT m_email IS NULL THEN 'Marketing Only' WHEN NOT s_email IS NULL THEN 'Sales Only' WHEN NOT z_email IS NULL THEN 'Support Only' ELSE 'Unknown' END

CASE WHEN composite >= 3.5 AND reliability >= 2 THEN 'Champion' WHEN composite >= 3.0 AND NOT m_email IS NULL AND NOT s_email IS NULL AND NOT z_email IS NULL THEN 'Loyal Customer' WHEN composite >= 2.5 AND reliability >= 2 THEN 'Potential Loyalist' WHEN composite >= 2.0 AND DATE_DIFF('DAY', first_touch, CURRENT_DATE) < 90 THEN 'New Customer' WHEN composite >= 1.5 THEN 'At Risk' WHEN composite > 0 THEN 'Hibernating' ELSE 'Lost' END

CASE WHEN reliability = 0 OR composite < 1 THEN 'High Risk' WHEN composite < 2 AND age_days > 365 THEN 'Medium Risk' WHEN last_activity < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '90' DAYS THEN 'Medium Risk' ELSE 'Low Risk' END

CASE segment WHEN 'Champion' THEN 'Upsell/Cross-sell' WHEN 'Loyal Customer' THEN 'Upsell/Cross-sell' WHEN 'Potential Loyalist' THEN 'Engagement Campaign' WHEN 'New Customer' THEN 'Onboarding Focus' WHEN 'At Risk' THEN 'Win-back Campaign' WHEN 'Hibernating' THEN 'Reactivation Campaign' ELSE 'Recovery Campaign' END

runtime_hits.line_text: select *, date_diff('day', first_touch, current_date)::bigint as age_days,
when composite >= 2.0 and date_diff('day', first_touch, current_date) < 90 then 'New Customer'
when last_activity < current_timestamp - interval '90 days' then 'Medium Risk' else 'Low Risk' end as churn_risk

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_customer360__customer_lifecycle_metrics
      description: Customer lifecycle metrics, health scoring, retention/churn risk, and cohort/tier enrichments derived from customer behavior analysis
      grain: One row per customer from intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis
      business_logic: 'Starting from intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis (one row per resolved customer), compute lifecycle metrics and enrichments: - Activity windows and recency: - days_since_last_activity = number of days between customer_last_activity and today; NULL if customer_last_activity is missing. - active_X_days flags (X ∈ {30,60,90,180,365}) = 1 if customer_last_activity occurred within X days of today, else 0; missing customer_last_activity yields 0. - Lifecycle stage (first match wins): - ''Acquisition'' if account_age_days ≤ 30 - ''Activation'' if account_age_days ≤ 90 and last_activity within 30 days - ''Growth'' if account_age_days ≤ 365 and last_activity within 60 days - ''Maturity'' if account_age_days > 365 and last_activity within 90 days - ''Dormant'' if last_activity older than 180 days - Else ''Retention'' - Note: NULL account_age_days or last_activity causes earlier conditions to fail and typically falls through to ''Retention''. - Cohort and platform consistency: - acquisition_cohort_month = month of the first touchpoint (truncated to month); NULL if first_touchpoint is missing. - platform_consistency_score ∈ {1,2,3}: sum of presence flags (in_marketo + in_stripe + in_zendesk); 3 if sum ≥ 3, 2 if sum = 2, else 1. NULL in any flag leads to the else path → 1. - Value and engagement scores: - estimated_customer_value (DECIMAL(6,2)) by customer_segment: - ''Champion'' 5000.00; ''Loyal Customer'' 3500.00; ''Potential Loyalist'' 2000.00; ''New Customer'' 800.00; ''At Risk'' 1200.00; ''Hibernating'' 500.00; else 200.00. - frequency_score (1–5): 5 if platform_consistency_score = 3 and active_30_days = 1; 4 if platform_consistency_score ≥ 2 and active_60_days = 1; 3 if platform_consistency_score ≥ 2 and active_90_days = 1; 2 if active_180_days = 1; else 1. - recency_score (1–5) by days_since_last_activity: 5 (≤7), 4 (≤30), 3 (≤60), 2 (≤180), else 1; NULL days_since_last_activity maps to 1. - estimated_transaction_count (DOUBLE): simulated per run: - If segment in (''Champion'',''Loyal Customer'') → integer 2–9 - If ''Potential Loyalist'' → integer 1–4 - Else → integer 0–1 - Stored as DOUBLE; values vary each execution. - customer_health_score (DECIMAL(15,2)) = rounded to 2 decimals from: recency_component*0.3 + platform_consistency_score*0.3 + segment_component*0.4, where: - recency_component: 5/4/3/2/1 as in recency_score logic - segment_component: ''Champion'' 5.0; ''Loyal Customer'' 4.5; ''Potential Loyalist'' 3.5; ''New Customer'' 3.0; ''At Risk'' 2.0; ''Hibernating'' 1.5; else 1.0 - Advanced lifecycle metrics: - estimated_customer_ltv (DECIMAL(18,2)) = estimated_customer_value × (1 + 0.2 × frequency_score) × (1 + 0.1 × platform_consistency_score) × stage_factor; rounded to 2 decimals, where stage_factor: Growth 1.5; Maturity 2.0; Retention 1.8; Activation 1.2; else 1.0. - retention_probability (DECIMAL(3,2)) by customer_health_score: ≥4.5→0.95; ≥4.0→0.85; ≥3.5→0.75; ≥3.0→0.65; ≥2.5→0.50; ≥2.0→0.35; else 0.20. - churn_probability (DECIMAL(3,2)) inverse mapping: ≥4.5→0.05; ≥4.0→0.15; ≥3.5→0.25; ≥3.0→0.35; ≥2.5→0.50; ≥2.0→0.65; else 0.80. - revenue_at_risk (DECIMAL(9,2)) = estimated_customer_value × churn-probability mapping above; rounded to 2 decimals. - growth_potential (first match wins): - ''High Growth Potential'' if lifecycle_stage in (''Acquisition'',''Activation'') and customer_health_score ≥ 3.5 - ''Expansion Ready'' if lifecycle_stage = ''Growth'' and platform_consistency_score ≥ 2 - ''Upsell Candidate'' if lifecycle_stage = ''Maturity'' and customer_health_score ≥ 4.0 - ''Stable Account'' if lifecycle_stage = ''Retention'' and customer_health_score ≥ 3.0 - ''Reactivation Needed'' if lifecycle_stage = ''Dormant'' - Else ''Monitor'' - action_priority (INT, first match wins): - 5 if churn-probability mapping ≥ 0.65 - 4 if lifecycle_stage = ''Acquisition'' and customer_health_score ≥ 3.5 - 4 if lifecycle_stage = ''Growth'' and platform_consistency_score ≥ 2 - 3 if customer_health_score ≥ 4.0 and estimated_customer_value ≥ 3000 - 3 if churn-probability mapping ≥ 0.35 - Else 2 - acquisition_year = year of acquisition_cohort_month; acquisition_month = month number; months_since_acquisition = whole months between acquisition_cohort_month and today; NULL if acquisition_cohort_month is NULL. - acquisition_season: ''Holiday Season'' if month in (11,12,1); ''Summer Season'' if in (6,7,8); ''Spring Season'' if in (3,4,5); else ''Fall Season'' (default for NULL or not matched). - Final enrichments: - customer_tier by estimated_customer_ltv: Platinum (≥8000), Gold (≥5000), Silver (≥2500), Bronze (≥1000), else Basic. - is_strategic_account = TRUE if estimated_customer_ltv ≥ 10000 OR (customer_segment in (''Champion'',''Loyal Customer'') AND platform_consistency_score = 3); else FALSE. - intervention_urgency by action_priority: 5→''Immediate''; 4→''This Week''; 3→''This Month''; else ''Routine''. - expected_retention_rate by LTV and lifecycle: 0.90 if LTV ≥ 8000; 0.85 if LTV ≥ 5000; 0.75 if LTV ≥ 2500 and lifecycle_stage ≠ ''Dormant''; 0.60 if LTV ≥ 1000 and lifecycle_stage in (''Growth'',''Maturity''); else 0.45. - performance_vs_expectation: ''Above Expectation'' if retention_probability > expected_retention_rate; ''Meeting Expectation'' if retention_probability ≥ 80% of expected_retention_rate; else ''Below Expectation''. - Output ordering: sorted by is_strategic_account (true first), then action_priority descending, then estimated_customer_ltv descending, then customer_health_score descending.'
      columns:
      - name: marketo_lead_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Marketo lead identifier; may be NULL
      - name: stripe_customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Stripe customer identifier
      - name: zendesk_user_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Zendesk user identifier; may be NULL
      - name: primary_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary resolved customer email
      - name: primary_organization
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Resolved customer organization or account label
      - name: customer_first_touchpoint
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest known customer interaction; used to derive acquisition_cohort_month
      - name: customer_last_activity
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Most recent activity timestamp; used for recency and active window flags
      - name: account_age_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Account age in days; used in lifecycle_stage rules
      - name: customer_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Behavioral segment driving value and scoring rules
      - name: customer_journey_pattern
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Descriptive journey pattern label
      - name: days_since_last_activity
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days between customer_last_activity and today; NULL if customer_last_activity is NULL
      - name: active_30_days
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 1 if last_activity within 30 days of today, else 0; NULL last_activity yields 0
      - name: active_60_days
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 1 if last_activity within 60 days of today, else 0; NULL last_activity yields 0
      - name: active_90_days
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 1 if last_activity within 90 days of today, else 0; NULL last_activity yields 0
      - name: active_180_days
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 1 if last_activity within 180 days of today, else 0; NULL last_activity yields 0
      - name: active_365_days
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 1 if last_activity within 365 days of today, else 0; NULL last_activity yields 0
      - name: lifecycle_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Stage from ordered rules using account_age_days and recency: Acquisition, Activation, Growth, Maturity, Dormant, else Retention'
      - name: acquisition_cohort_month
        data_type: DATE
        description: Month of first touchpoint; NULL if customer_first_touchpoint is NULL
      - name: platform_consistency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Cross-platform presence score: 3 if all three sources, 2 if two, else 1; NULL flags fall through to 1'
      - name: estimated_customer_value
        data_type: DECIMAL(6,2)
        description: Segment-based monetary value estimate with fixed mapping; never NULL
      - name: frequency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Engagement frequency score (1–5) from platform consistency and recent activity per ordered rules
      - name: recency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Recency score (1–5) from days_since_last_activity thresholds; NULL recency maps to 1
      - name: estimated_transaction_count
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Simulated integer count: 2–9 for top segments, 1–4 for Potential Loyalist, else 0–1; varies each run'
      - name: customer_health_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(15,2)
        description: 'Weighted composite: 0.3×recency_component + 0.3×platform_consistency + 0.4×segment_component; rounded to 2 decimals'
      - name: estimated_customer_ltv
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: LTV estimate from value × frequency × platform × stage_factor; rounded to 2 decimals
      - name: retention_probability
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,2)
        description: Probability mapped from customer_health_score thresholds (≥4.5→0.95 down to else 0.20)
      - name: churn_probability
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,2)
        description: Inverse of retention mapping from customer_health_score (≥4.5→0.05 up to else 0.80)
      - name: revenue_at_risk
        data_type: DECIMAL(9,2)
        description: Estimated_customer_value multiplied by churn mapping; rounded to 2 decimals
      - name: growth_potential
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Categorical potential per ordered rules using lifecycle_stage, platform consistency, and health score
      - name: action_priority
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Next-action priority (2–5) from ordered rules using churn mapping, lifecycle, platform consistency, health, and value
      - name: acquisition_year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Year extracted from acquisition_cohort_month; NULL if acquisition_cohort_month is NULL
      - name: acquisition_month
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Month number (1–12) extracted from acquisition_cohort_month; NULL if acquisition_cohort_month is NULL
      - name: months_since_acquisition
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Whole months between acquisition_cohort_month and today; NULL if acquisition_cohort_month is NULL
      - name: acquisition_season
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Season by acquisition month: Holiday (11,12,1), Summer (6,7,8), Spring (3,4,5), else Fall (default for NULL/not matched)'
      - name: customer_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tier by estimated_customer_ltv: Platinum (≥8000), Gold (≥5000), Silver (≥2500), Bronze (≥1000), else Basic'
      - name: is_strategic_account
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: TRUE if estimated_customer_ltv ≥ 10000 or (segment in ('Champion','Loyal Customer') and platform_consistency_score = 3), else FALSE
      - name: intervention_urgency
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Urgency label by action_priority: 5→Immediate; 4→This Week; 3→This Month; else Routine'
      - name: expected_retention_rate
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,2)
        description: 'Expected rate by LTV and lifecycle: 0.90, 0.85, 0.75 (non-Dormant), 0.60 (Growth/Maturity), else 0.45'
      - name: performance_vs_expectation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Comparison of retention_probability vs expected_retention_rate: Above (>), Meeting (≥80%), or Below'

3 if platform_consistency_score ≥ 2 and active_90_days = 1; 2 if active_180_days = 1; else 1. - recency_score (1–5) by days_since_last_activity: 5 (≤7), 4 (≤30), 3 (≤60), 2 (≤180), else 1; NULL days_since_last_activity maps to 1. - estimated_transaction_count (DOUBLE): simulated per run: - If segment in (''Champion'',''Loyal Customer'') → integer 2–9 - If ''Potential Loyalist'' → integer 1–4 - Else → integer 0–1 - Stored as DOUBLE; values vary each execution. - customer_health_score (DECIMAL(15,2)) = rounded to 2 decimals from: recency_component*0.3 + platform_consistency_score*0.3 + segment_component*0.4, where: - recency_component: 5/4/3/2/1 as in recency_score logic - segment_component: ''Champion'' 5.0; ''Loyal Customer'' 4.5; ''Potential Loyalist'' 3.5; ''New Customer'' 3.0; ''At Risk'' 2.0; ''Hibernating'' 1.5; else 1.0 - Advanced lifecycle metrics: - estimated_customer_ltv (DECIMAL(18,2)) = estimated_customer_value × (1 + 0.2 × frequency_score) × (1 + 0.1 × platform_consistency_score) × stage_factor; rounded to 2 decimals, where stage_factor: Growth 1.5; Maturity 2.0; Retention 1.8; Activation 1.2; else 1.0. - retention_probability (DECIMAL(3,2)) by customer_health_score: ≥4.5→0.95; ≥4.0→0.85; ≥3.5→0.75; ≥3.0→0.65; ≥2.5→0.50; ≥2.0→0.35; else 0.20. - churn_probability (DECIMAL(3,2)) inverse mapping: ≥4.5→0.05; ≥4.0→0.15; ≥3.5→0.25; ≥3.0→0.35; ≥2.5→0.50; ≥2.0→0.65; else 0.80. - revenue_at_risk (DECIMAL(9,2)) = estimated_customer_value × churn-probability mapping above; rounded to 2 decimals. - growth_potential (first match wins): - ''High Growth Potential'' if lifecycle_stage in (''Acquisition'',''Activation'') and customer_health_score ≥ 3.5 - ''Expansion Ready'' if lifecycle_stage = ''Growth'' and platform_consistency_score ≥ 2 - ''Upsell Candidate'' if lifecycle_stage = ''Maturity'' and customer_health_score ≥ 4.0 - ''Stable Account'' if lifecycle_stage = ''Retention'' and customer_health_score ≥ 3.0 - ''Reactivation Needed'' if lifecycle_stage = ''Dormant'' - Else ''Monitor'' - action_priority (INT, first match wins): - 5 if churn-probability mapping ≥ 0.65 - 4 if lifecycle_stage = ''Acquisition'' and customer_health_score ≥ 3.5 - 4 if lifecycle_stage = ''Growth'' and platform_consistency_score ≥ 2 - 3 if customer_health_score ≥ 4.0 and estimated_customer_value ≥ 3000 - 3 if churn-probability mapping ≥ 0.35 - Else 2 - acquisition_year = year of acquisition_cohort_month; acquisition_month = month number; months_since_acquisition = whole months between acquisition_cohort_month and today; NULL if acquisition_cohort_month is NULL. - acquisition_season: ''Holiday Season'' if month in (11,12,1); ''Summer Season'' if in (6,7,8); ''Spring Season'' if in (3,4,5); else ''Fall Season'' (default for NULL or not matched). - Final enrichments: - customer_tier by estimated_customer_ltv: Platinum (≥8000), Gold (≥5000), Silver (≥2500), Bronze (≥1000), else Basic. - is_strategic_account = TRUE if estimated_customer_ltv ≥ 10000 OR (customer_segment in (''Champion'',''Loyal Customer'') AND platform_consistency_score = 3); else FALSE. - intervention_urgency by action_priority: 5→''Immediate''; 4→''This Week''; 3→''This Month''; else ''Routine''. - expected_retention_rate by LTV and lifecycle: 0.90 if LTV ≥ 8000; 0.85 if LTV ≥ 5000; 0.75 if LTV ≥ 2500 and lifecycle_stage ≠ ''Dormant''; 0.60 if LTV ≥ 1000 and lifecycle_stage in (''Growth'',''Maturity''); else 0.45. - performance_vs_expectation: ''Above Expectation'' if retention_probability > expected_retention_rate; ''Meeting Expectation'' if retention_probability ≥ 80% of expected_retention_rate; else ''Below Expectation''. - Output ordering: sorted by is_strategic_account (true first), then action_priority descending, then estimated_customer_ltv descending, then customer_health_score descending.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_customer360__risk_assessment
      description: Multi-dimensional customer risk assessment derived from behavior, lifecycle, payment, and support signals with computed scores, classifications, flags, interventions, ROI, and timestamp
      grain: One row per intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis record with non-null primary_email
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis
      - intermediate.int_customer360__customer_lifecycle_metrics
      - intermediate.int_customer360__stripe
      - intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk
      business_logic: 'Build engagement_risk_scoring: - Input rows from intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis (ba) left joined to intermediate.int_customer360__customer_lifecycle_metrics (lm) on primary_email. - Compute days_since_last_activity as the number of days between ba.customer_last_activity and today; set to NULL if ba.customer_last_activity is missing. - activity_decline_risk: >90 days → 3; >60 days → 2; >30 days → 1; otherwise → 0. - platform_abandonment_risk from presence across Marketo/Stripe/Zendesk (ba.in_marketo + ba.in_stripe + ba.in_zendesk): sum = 1 → 2; sum = 2 → 1; otherwise → 0. - lifecycle_transition_risk: Dormant → 3; Retention with customer_health_score < 3.0 → 2; Acquisition/Activation with days_since_last_activity > 30 → 2; otherwise → 0. - email_engagement_risk (only if marketo_lead_id is present): days_since_last_activity > 60 → 2; else if composite_engagement_score < 2.0 → 1; otherwise → 0; if marketo_lead_id is missing → 0. Build payment_risk_scoring: - Left join intermediate.int_customer360__stripe (s) on ers.stripe_customer_id = s.customer_id. - payment_behavior_risk precedence: is_delinquent = true → 3; else if is_deleted = true → 4; else if estimated_customer_ltv > 5000 and churn_probability > 0.5 → 2; otherwise → 0. - account_stability_risk: stripe customer exists and days between created_at and updated_at < 30 → 1; else if is_deleted = true → 3; otherwise → 0. - revenue_at_risk_score precedence: LTV ≥ 10000 and churn ≥ 0.5 → 4; else if LTV ≥ 5000 and churn ≥ 0.5 → 3; else if LTV ≥ 2000 and churn ≥ 0.7 → 2; else if churn ≥ 0.8 → 1; otherwise → 0. Build support_risk_scoring: - Left join intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk (z) on prs.zendesk_user_id = z.user_id. - support_engagement_risk precedence: suspended → 3; else if deleted → 2; else if active = false → 2; else if user present and last_update was > 90 days ago → 1; otherwise → 0. - org_relationship_risk: missing organization_id with non-missing primary_organization → 1; else if suspended with organization_id present → 2; otherwise → 0. - satisfaction_risk_score precedence: segment in (''At Risk'',''Hibernating'',''Lost'') → 2; else if churn_risk_level = ''High Risk'' → 3; else if lifecycle_stage = ''Dormant'' and zendesk_active = false → 2; otherwise → 0. Build comprehensive_risk_assessment: - total_risk_score = weighted sum of seven risk components (weights: 0.2 activity_decline, 0.15 platform_abandonment, 0.15 lifecycle_transition, 0.1 email_engagement, 0.25 payment_behavior, 0.1 account_stability, 0.05 revenue_at_risk), rounded to 2 decimals. - risk_category from the unweighted sum S of the seven components: S ≥ 8 → Critical; S ≥ 5 → High; S ≥ 3 → Medium; S ≥ 1 → Low; otherwise → Minimal. - primary_risk_factor precedence: Payment Issues; else Engagement Decline; else Lifecycle Transition; else High Value at Risk; else Support Issues; else Communication Breakdown; else Standard Monitoring. - risk_trend precedence: days_since_last_activity ≤ 7 with customer_health_score ≥ 4.0 → Improving; else if days_since_last_activity ≤ 30 with churn_probability < 0.3 → Stable; else if 30 < days_since_last_activity ≤ 60 → Declining; else if days_since_last_activity > 60 → Deteriorating; otherwise → Unknown. - potential_revenue_loss = estimated_customer_ltv × churn_probability, rounded to 2 decimals. - intervention_timeline precedence: payment_behavior_risk ≥ 3 → Immediate (24h); else if activity_decline_risk + platform_abandonment_risk + lifecycle_transition_risk ≥ 5 → Urgent (1 week); else if revenue_at_risk_score ≥ 3 → High Priority (2 weeks); else if activity_decline_risk + email_engagement_risk ≥ 3 → Medium Priority (1 month); otherwise → Standard Priority. - recommended_intervention precedence: Account Management Call; else Executive Outreach (activity_decline_risk ≥ 2 and LTV ≥ 5000); else Customer Success Check-in; else Personalized Email Campaign; else Product Adoption Workshop; else Lifecycle-specific Campaign; otherwise Automated Monitoring. - intervention_success_probability from S (same sum used for risk_category): S ≥ 8 → 0.30; S ≥ 5 → 0.60; S ≥ 3 → 0.80; S ≥ 1 → 0.90; otherwise → 0.95. Build final_risk_assessment: - customer_priority_score = (risk_category score × 0.6) + (LTV bracket score × 0.4), then rounded; risk_category scores: Critical=5, High=4, Medium=3, Low=2, Minimal=1; LTV brackets: ≥10000=5, ≥5000=4, ≥2000=3, ≥1000=2, else=1. Note: logic rounds to 2 decimals; stored with one-decimal precision per column type. - risk_adjusted_customer_value = estimated_customer_ltv × (1 − churn_probability) × intervention_success_probability, rounded to 2 decimals. - critical_alert_flag = payment_behavior_risk ≥ 3 OR revenue_at_risk_score ≥ 4. - high_value_at_risk_flag = activity_decline_risk ≥ 2 AND estimated_customer_ltv ≥ 3000. - engagement_warning_flag = platform_abandonment_risk ≥ 2 AND customer_health_score < 3.0. - intervention_roi = (estimated_customer_ltv × intervention_success_probability × 0.7) − cost, rounded to 2 decimals; cost by recommended_intervention: Account Management Call=500; Executive Outreach=1000; Customer Success Check-in=200; Personalized Email Campaign=50; Product Adoption Workshop=300; Lifecycle-specific Campaign=100; otherwise=25. - risk_assessment_timestamp = current execution timestamp with time zone. - Final filter: include only rows with non-null primary_email. - Ordering: sort by critical_alert_flag (descending), then customer_priority_score (descending), potential_revenue_loss (descending), and total_risk_score (descending).'
      columns:
      - name: marketo_lead_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Marketo lead identifier from behavior_analysis; NULL allowed; used to gate email_engagement_risk
      - name: stripe_customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Stripe customer identifier from behavior_analysis; join key to stripe_data; NULL allowed
      - name: zendesk_user_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Zendesk user identifier from behavior_analysis; join key to zendesk_data; NULL allowed
      - name: primary_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary customer email; final output filtered to non-NULL; duplicates preserved
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: primary_organization
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer organization name from behavior_analysis; used in org_relationship_risk; NULL allowed
      - name: composite_engagement_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(14,1)
        description: Behavioral engagement score from behavior_analysis; used in email_engagement_risk; no rounding applied here
      - name: customer_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Behavioral segment from behavior_analysis; used in satisfaction_risk_score; NULL allowed
      - name: churn_risk_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Categorical churn risk level from behavior_analysis; used in satisfaction_risk_score and primary_risk_factor
      - name: days_since_last_activity
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days between last recorded customer activity and today; NULL if no activity timestamp
      - name: customer_health_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(15,2)
        description: Lifecycle health score from lifecycle_metrics; used in lifecycle_transition_risk and risk_trend; NULL allowed
      - name: lifecycle_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lifecycle stage from lifecycle_metrics; used in lifecycle_transition_risk, satisfaction_risk_score, and recommended_intervention
      - name: active_30_days
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Activity count/flag over last 30 days from lifecycle_metrics; passthrough; NULL allowed
      - name: active_90_days
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Activity count/flag over last 90 days from lifecycle_metrics; passthrough; NULL allowed
      - name: platform_consistency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Consistency score across platforms from lifecycle_metrics; passthrough; NULL allowed
      - name: estimated_customer_ltv
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Estimated customer lifetime value from lifecycle_metrics; used in revenue_at_risk_score, interventions, ROI, and value calculations
      - name: churn_probability
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,2)
        description: Lifecycle churn probability from lifecycle_metrics; used in multiple calculations; range [0,1]; NULL allowed
      - name: activity_decline_risk
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk bucket: days_since_last_activity >90 →3; >60 →2; >30 →1; else →0; NULL days_since_last_activity yields 0'
      - name: platform_abandonment_risk
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk bucket from sum of presence flags (in_marketo + in_stripe + in_zendesk): sum=1 →2; sum=2 →1; else →0'
      - name: lifecycle_transition_risk
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk bucket: Dormant →3; Retention with customer_health_score<3.0 →2; Acquisition/Activation with days_since_last_activity>30 →2; else →0'
      - name: email_engagement_risk
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk bucket if marketo_lead_id present: days_since_last_activity>60 →2; else if composite_engagement_score<2.0 →1; else →0; if marketo_lead_id missing →0'
      - name: is_delinquent
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Stripe delinquency flag from stripe_data; NULL if no stripe record
      - name: stripe_deleted
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Stripe deletion flag from stripe_data; NULL if no stripe record
      - name: stripe_account_created
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Stripe account creation timestamp from stripe_data; NULL if no stripe record
      - name: stripe_last_update
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Stripe last update timestamp from stripe_data; NULL if no stripe record
      - name: payment_behavior_risk
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk bucket precedence: is_delinquent=true →3; else if stripe_deleted=true →4; else if LTV>5000 and churn_probability>0.5 →2; else →0'
      - name: account_stability_risk
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk bucket: stripe customer exists and days between created_at and updated_at <30 →1; else if stripe_deleted=true →3; else →0'
      - name: revenue_at_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk bucket precedence: LTV≥10000 and churn≥0.5 →4; else LTV≥5000 and churn≥0.5 →3; else LTV≥2000 and churn≥0.7 →2; else churn≥0.8 →1; else →0'
      - name: zendesk_active
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Zendesk active flag from zendesk_data; NULL if no zendesk record
      - name: zendesk_suspended
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Zendesk suspended flag from zendesk_data; NULL if no zendesk record
      - name: zendesk_deleted
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Zendesk deletion flag from zendesk_data; NULL if no zendesk record
      - name: organization_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Zendesk organization_id; used in org_relationship_risk; NULL allowed
      - name: zendesk_account_created
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Zendesk account creation timestamp from zendesk_data; NULL if no zendesk record
      - name: zendesk_last_update
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Zendesk last update timestamp from zendesk_data; NULL if no zendesk record
      - name: support_engagement_risk
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk bucket precedence: suspended →3; else deleted →2; else active=false →2; else if user present and last_update>90 days →1; else →0'
      - name: org_relationship_risk
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk bucket: NULL organization_id with non-NULL primary_organization →1; suspended with non-NULL organization_id →2; else →0'
      - name: satisfaction_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk bucket precedence: segment in (''At Risk'',''Hibernating'',''Lost'') →2; else churn_risk_level=''High Risk'' →3; else Dormant and zendesk_active=false →2; else →0'
      - name: total_risk_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Weighted sum of seven risk components (0.2, 0.15, 0.15, 0.1, 0.25, 0.1, 0.05), rounded to 2 decimals
      - name: risk_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Classification from the sum of seven risk components: ≥8 Critical; ≥5 High; ≥3 Medium; ≥1 Low; else Minimal'
      - name: primary_risk_factor
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Primary factor by precedence: Payment Issues; Engagement Decline; Lifecycle Transition; High Value at Risk; Support Issues; Communication Breakdown; else Standard Monitoring'
      - name: risk_trend
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Trend by precedence: Improving; Stable; Declining; Deteriorating; else Unknown, based on days_since_last_activity, customer_health_score, and churn_probability'
      - name: potential_revenue_loss
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Estimated loss as LTV × churn_probability, rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if either input is NULL
      - name: intervention_timeline
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Time sensitivity by precedence: Immediate (24h); Urgent (1 week); High Priority (2 weeks); Medium Priority (1 month); else Standard Priority'
      - name: recommended_intervention
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Intervention by precedence: Account Management Call; Executive Outreach; Customer Success Check-in; Personalized Email Campaign; Product Adoption Workshop; Lifecycle-specific Campaign; else Automated Monitoring'
      - name: intervention_success_probability
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,2)
        description: 'Success probability from the sum of seven risk components: ≥8 → 0.30; ≥5 → 0.60; ≥3 → 0.80; ≥1 → 0.90; else → 0.95'
      - name: customer_priority_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(13,1)
        description: Overall priority = (risk_category score × 0.6) + (LTV bracket score × 0.4); logic rounds to 2 decimals and value is stored with one-decimal precision
      - name: risk_adjusted_customer_value
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Value = LTV × (1 − churn_probability) × intervention_success_probability, rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if inputs are NULL
      - name: critical_alert_flag
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if payment_behavior_risk ≥ 3 or revenue_at_risk_score ≥ 4; else false
      - name: high_value_at_risk_flag
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if activity_decline_risk ≥ 2 and estimated_customer_ltv ≥ 3000; else false
      - name: engagement_warning_flag
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if platform_abandonment_risk ≥ 2 and customer_health_score < 3.0; else false
      - name: intervention_roi
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: ROI = (LTV × intervention_success_probability × 0.7) − intervention cost, rounded to 2 decimals; cost per intervention per defined schedule
      - name: risk_assessment_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Execution timestamp captured at run time with time zone

alternatives.expression_sql: CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', customer_last_activity, CURRENT_DATE) > 90 THEN 3 WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', customer_last_activity, CURRENT_DATE) > 60 THEN 2 WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', customer_last_activity, CURRENT_DATE) > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
CASE WHEN in_marketo + in_stripe + in_zendesk = 1 THEN 2 WHEN in_marketo + in_stripe + in_zendesk = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

CASE WHEN lifecycle_stage = 'Dormant' THEN 3 WHEN lifecycle_stage = 'Retention' AND customer_health_score < 3 THEN 2 WHEN lifecycle_stage IN ('Acquisition', 'Activation') AND DATE_DIFF('DAY', customer_last_activity, CURRENT_DATE) > 30 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END
CASE WHEN marketo_lead_id IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', customer_last_activity, CURRENT_DATE) > 60 THEN 2 WHEN composite_engagement_score < 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
CASE WHEN is_delinquent THEN 3 WHEN stripe_deleted THEN 4 WHEN estimated_customer_ltv > 5000 AND churn_probability > 0.5 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END
CASE WHEN NOT stripe_customer_id IS NULL AND DATE_DIFF('DAY', stripe_account_created, stripe_last_update) < 30 THEN 1 WHEN stripe_deleted THEN 3 ELSE 0 END

CASE WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 10000 AND churn_probability >= 0.5 THEN 4 WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 5000 AND churn_probability >= 0.5 THEN 3 WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 2000 AND churn_probability >= 0.7 THEN 2 WHEN churn_probability >= 0.8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

CASE WHEN zendesk_suspended THEN 3 WHEN zendesk_deleted THEN 2 WHEN zendesk_active = FALSE THEN 2 WHEN NOT zendesk_user_id IS NULL AND zendesk_last_update < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '90' DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
CASE WHEN organization_id IS NULL AND NOT primary_organization IS NULL THEN 1 WHEN zendesk_suspended AND NOT organization_id IS NULL THEN 2 ELSE 0 END
CASE WHEN customer_segment IN ('At Risk', 'Hibernating', 'Lost') THEN 2 WHEN churn_risk_level = 'High Risk' THEN 3 WHEN lifecycle_stage = 'Dormant' AND zendesk_active = FALSE THEN 2 ELSE 0 END

ROUND(activity_decline_risk * 0.2 + platform_abandonment_risk * 0.15 + lifecycle_transition_risk * 0.15 + email_engagement_risk * 0.1 + payment_behavior_risk * 0.25 + account_stability_risk * 0.1 + revenue_at_risk_score * 0.05, 2)
CASE WHEN S >= 8 THEN 'Critical' WHEN S >= 5 THEN 'High' WHEN S >= 3 THEN 'Medium' WHEN S >= 1 THEN 'Low' ELSE 'Minimal' END

CASE WHEN payment_behavior_risk > 0 THEN 'Payment Issues' WHEN activity_decline_risk > 0 THEN 'Engagement Decline' WHEN lifecycle_transition_risk > 0 THEN 'Lifecycle Transition' WHEN revenue_at_risk_score > 0 THEN 'High Value at Risk' WHEN support_engagement_risk > 0 THEN 'Support Issues' WHEN email_engagement_risk > 0 THEN 'Communication Breakdown' ELSE 'Standard Monitoring' END

CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', customer_last_activity, CURRENT_DATE) <= 7 AND customer_health_score >= 4 THEN 'Improving' WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', customer_last_activity, CURRENT_DATE) <= 30 AND churn_probability < 0.3 THEN 'Stable' WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', customer_last_activity, CURRENT_DATE) BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN 'Declining' WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', customer_last_activity, CURRENT_DATE) > 60 THEN 'Deteriorating' ELSE 'Unknown' END

CASE WHEN payment_behavior_risk >= 3 THEN 'Immediate (24h)' WHEN activity_decline_risk + platform_abandonment_risk + lifecycle_transition_risk >= 5 THEN 'Urgent (1 week)' WHEN revenue_at_risk_score >= 3 THEN 'High Priority (2 weeks)' WHEN activity_decline_risk + email_engagement_risk >= 3 THEN 'Medium Priority (1 month)' ELSE 'Standard Priority' END

CASE WHEN payment_behavior_risk > 0 THEN 'Account Management Call' WHEN activity_decline_risk >= 2 AND estimated_customer_ltv >= 5000 THEN 'Executive Outreach' WHEN support_engagement_risk > 0 THEN 'Customer Success Check-in' WHEN email_engagement_risk > 0 THEN 'Personalized Email Campaign' WHEN platform_abandonment_risk > 0 THEN 'Product Adoption Workshop' WHEN NOT lifecycle_stage IS NULL THEN 'Lifecycle-specific Campaign' ELSE 'Automated Monitoring' END
CASE WHEN S >= 8 THEN 0.30 WHEN S >= 5 THEN 0.60 WHEN S >= 3 THEN 0.80 WHEN S >= 1 THEN 0.90 ELSE 0.95 END

CAST(ROUND((CASE risk_category WHEN 'Critical' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 4 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 3 WHEN 'Low' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END * 0.6 + CASE WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 10000 THEN 5 WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 5000 THEN 4 WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 2000 THEN 3 WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 1000 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END * 0.4), 2) AS DECIMAL(13, 1))

ROUND(estimated_customer_ltv * intervention_success_probability * 0.7 - CASE recommended_intervention WHEN 'Account Management Call' THEN 500 WHEN 'Executive Outreach' THEN 1000 WHEN 'Customer Success Check-in' THEN 200 WHEN 'Personalized Email Campaign' THEN 50 WHEN 'Product Adoption Workshop' THEN 300 WHEN 'Lifecycle-specific Campaign' THEN 100 ELSE 25 END, 2)

references.name: intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis
references.line_text: business_logic: 'Build engagement_risk_scoring: - Input rows from intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis (ba) left joined to intermediate.int_customer360__customer_lifecycle_metrics (lm) on primary_email. - Compute days_since_last_activity as the number of days between ba.customer_last_activity and today; set to NULL if ba.customer_last_activity is missing. - activity_decline_risk: >90 days → 3; >60 days → 2; >30 days → 1; otherwise → 0. - platform_abandonment_risk from presence across Marketo/Stripe/Zendesk (ba.in_marketo + ba.in_stripe + ba.in_zendesk): sum = 1 → 2; sum = 2 → 1; otherwise → 0. - lifecycle_transition_risk: Dormant → 3; Retention with customer_health_score < 3.0 → 2; Acquisition/Activation with days_since_last_activity > 30 → 2; otherwise → 0. - email_engagement_risk (only if marketo_lead_id is present): days_since_last_activity > 60 → 2; else if composite_engagement_score < 2.0 → 1; otherwise → 0; if marketo_lead_id is missing → 0. Build payment_risk_scoring: - Left join intermediate.int_customer360__stripe (s) on ers.stripe_customer_id = s.customer_id. - payment_behavior_risk precedence: is_delinquent = true → 3; else if is_deleted = true → 4; else if estimated_customer_ltv > 5000 and churn_probability > 0.5 → 2; otherwise → 0. - account_stability_risk: stripe customer exists and days between created_at and updated_at < 30 → 1; else if is_deleted = true → 3; otherwise → 0. - revenue_at_risk_score precedence: LTV ≥ 10000 and churn ≥ 0.5 → 4; else if LTV ≥ 5000 and churn ≥ 0.5 → 3; else if LTV ≥ 2000 and churn ≥ 0.7 → 2; else if churn ≥ 0.8 → 1; otherwise → 0. Build support_risk_scoring: - Left join intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk (z) on prs.zendesk_user_id = z.user_id. - support_engagement_risk precedence: suspended → 3; else if deleted → 2; else if active = false → 2; else if user present and last_update was > 90 days ago → 1; otherwise → 0. - org_relationship_risk: missing organization_id with non-missing primary_organization → 1; else if suspended with organization_id present → 2; otherwise → 0. - satisfaction_risk_score precedence: segment in (''At Risk'',''Hibernating'',''Lost'') → 2; else if churn_risk_level = ''High Risk'' → 3; else if lifecycle_stage = ''Dormant'' and zendesk_active = false → 2; otherwise → 0. Build comprehensive_risk_assessment: - total_risk_score = weighted sum of seven risk components (weights: 0.2 activity_decline, 0.15 platform_abandonment, 0.15 lifecycle_transition, 0.1 email_engagement, 0.25 payment_behavior, 0.1 account_stability, 0.05 revenue_at_risk), rounded to 2 decimals. - risk_category from the unweighted sum S of the seven components: S ≥ 8 → Critical; S ≥ 5 → High; S ≥ 3 → Medium; S ≥ 1 → Low; otherwise → Minimal. - primary_risk_factor precedence: Payment Issues; else Engagement Decline; else Lifecycle Transition; else High Value at Risk; else Support Issues; else Communication Breakdown; else Standard Monitoring. - risk_trend precedence: days_since_last_activity ≤ 7 with customer_health_score ≥ 4.0 → Improving; else if days_since_last_activity ≤ 30 with churn_probability < 0.3 → Stable; else if 30 < days_since_last_activity ≤ 60 → Declining; else if days_since_last_activity > 60 → Deteriorating; otherwise → Unknown. - potential_revenue_loss = estimated_customer_ltv × churn_probability, rounded to 2 decimals. - intervention_timeline precedence: payment_behavior_risk ≥ 3 → Immediate (24h); else if activity_decline_risk + platform_abandonment_risk + lifecycle_transition_risk ≥ 5 → Urgent (1 week); else if revenue_at_risk_score ≥ 3 → High Priority (2 weeks); else if activity_decline_risk + email_engagement_risk ≥ 3 → Medium Priority (1 month); otherwise → Standard Priority. - recommended_intervention precedence: Account Management Call; else Executive Outreach (activity_decline_risk ≥ 2 and LTV ≥ 5000); else Customer Success Check-in; else Personalized Email Campaign; else Product Adoption Workshop; else Lifecycle-specific Campaign; otherwise Automated Monitoring. - intervention_success_probability from S (same sum used for risk_category): S ≥ 8 → 0.30; S ≥ 5 → 0.60; S ≥ 3 → 0.80; S ≥ 1 → 0.90; otherwise → 0.95. Build final_risk_assessment: - customer_priority_score = (risk_category score × 0.6) + (LTV bracket score × 0.4), then rounded; risk_category scores: Critical=5, High=4, Medium=3, Low=2, Minimal=1; LTV brackets: ≥10000=5, ≥5000=4, ≥2000=3, ≥1000=2, else=1. Note: logic rounds to 2 decimals; stored with one-decimal precision per column type. - risk_adjusted_customer_value = estimated_customer_ltv × (1 − churn_probability) × intervention_success_probability, rounded to 2 decimals. - critical_alert_flag = payment_behavior_risk ≥ 3 OR revenue_at_risk_score ≥ 4. - high_value_at_risk_flag = activity_decline_risk ≥ 2 AND estimated_customer_ltv ≥ 3000. - engagement_warning_flag = platform_abandonment_risk ≥ 2 AND customer_health_score < 3.0. - intervention_roi = (estimated_customer_ltv × intervention_success_probability × 0.7) − cost, rounded to 2 decimals; cost by recommended_intervention: Account Management Call=500; Executive Outreach=1000; Customer Success Check-in=200; Personalized Email Campaign=50; Product Adoption Workshop=300; Lifecycle-specific Campaign=100; otherwise=25. - risk_assessment_timestamp = current execution timestamp with time zone. - Final filter: include only rows with non-null primary_email. - Ordering: sort by critical_alert_flag (descending), then customer_priority_score (descending), potential_revenue_loss (descending), and total_risk_score (descending).'

Build comprehensive_risk_assessment: - total_risk_score = weighted sum of seven risk components (weights: 0.2 activity_decline, 0.15 platform_abandonment, 0.15 lifecycle_transition, 0.1 email_engagement, 0.25 payment_behavior, 0.1 account_stability, 0.05 revenue_at_risk), rounded to 2 decimals. - risk_category from the unweighted sum S of the seven components: S ≥ 8 → Critical; S ≥ 5 → High; S ≥ 3 → Medium; S ≥ 1 → Low; otherwise → Minimal. - primary_risk_factor precedence: Payment Issues; else Engagement Decline; else Lifecycle Transition; else High Value at Risk; else Support Issues; else Communication Breakdown; else Standard Monitoring. - risk_trend precedence: days_since_last_activity ≤ 7 with customer_health_score ≥ 4.0 → Improving; else if days_since_last_activity ≤ 30 with churn_probability < 0.3 → Stable; else if 30 < days_since_last_activity ≤ 60 → Declining; else if days_since_last_activity > 60 → Deteriorating; otherwise → Unknown. - potential_revenue_loss = estimated_customer_ltv × churn_probability, rounded to 2 decimals. - intervention_timeline precedence: payment_behavior_risk ≥ 3 → Immediate (24h); else if activity_decline_risk + platform_abandonment_risk + lifecycle_transition_risk ≥ 5 → Urgent (1 week); else if revenue_at_risk_score ≥ 3 → High Priority (2 weeks); else if activity_decline_risk + email_engagement_risk ≥ 3 → Medium Priority (1 month); otherwise → Standard Priority. - recommended_intervention precedence: Account Management Call; else Executive Outreach (activity_decline_risk ≥ 2 and LTV ≥ 5000); else Customer Success Check-in; else Personalized Email Campaign; else Product Adoption Workshop; else Lifecycle-specific Campaign; otherwise Automated Monitoring. - intervention_success_probability from S (same sum used for risk_category): S ≥ 8 → 0.30; S ≥ 5 → 0.60; S ≥ 3 → 0.80; S ≥ 1 → 0.90; otherwise → 0.95. Build final_risk_assessment: - customer_priority_score = (risk_category score × 0.6) + (LTV bracket score × 0.4), then rounded; risk_category scores: Critical=5, High=4, Medium=3, Low=2, Minimal=1; LTV brackets: ≥10000=5, ≥5000=4, ≥2000=3, ≥1000=2, else=1. Note: logic rounds to 2 decimals; stored with one-decimal precision per column type. - risk_adjusted_customer_value = estimated_customer_ltv × (1 − churn_probability) × intervention_success_probability, rounded to 2 decimals. - critical_alert_flag = payment_behavior_risk ≥ 3 OR revenue_at_risk_score ≥ 4. - high_value_at_risk_flag = activity_decline_risk ≥ 2 AND estimated_customer_ltv ≥ 3000. - engagement_warning_flag = platform_abandonment_risk ≥ 2 AND customer_health_score < 3.0. - intervention_roi = (estimated_customer_ltv × intervention_success_probability × 0.7) − cost, rounded to 2 decimals; cost by recommended_intervention: Account Management Call=500; Executive Outreach=1000; Customer Success Check-in=200; Personalized Email Campaign=50; Product Adoption Workshop=300; Lifecycle-specific Campaign=100; otherwise=25. - risk_assessment_timestamp = current execution timestamp with time zone. - Final filter: include only rows with non-null primary_email. - Ordering: sort by critical_alert_flag (descending), then customer_priority_score (descending), potential_revenue_loss (descending), and total_risk_score (descending).'

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_customer360__source_matches
      description: Email-based identity matches across Marketo, Stripe, and Zendesk with coalesced IDs and combined timestamps (overall latest/earliest across systems and preferred-source values).
      grain: One row per merged match of (marketo_lead_id, stripe_customer_id, zendesk_user_id) produced by full outer joins of the pairwise email matches; duplicates may occur when inputs contain multiple rows for the same email.
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_customer360__marketo_for_matching
      - intermediate.int_customer360__stripe_for_matching
      - intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk_for_matching
      business_logic: '- Build three pairwise match sets using exact email equality (no normalization): - Marketo↔Stripe on identical email. - Marketo↔Zendesk on identical email. - Stripe↔Zendesk on identical email. - Merge matches: - Full outer join Marketo↔Stripe with Marketo↔Zendesk on Marketo lead ID. - Full outer join the result with Stripe↔Zendesk when either Stripe customer ID matches or Zendesk user ID matches. - Derive IDs: - Marketo lead ID: take the Marketo ID from the Marketo↔Stripe match when present; otherwise from the Marketo↔Zendesk match. - Stripe customer ID: take the Stripe ID from the Marketo↔Stripe match when present; otherwise from the Stripe↔Zendesk match. - Zendesk user ID: take the Zendesk ID from the Marketo↔Zendesk match when present; otherwise from the Stripe↔Zendesk match. - Derive timestamps: - Overall updated_at (named marketo_updated_at): choose the latest non-null among the Marketo, Stripe, and Zendesk updated_at values available from the merged matches. - Stripe updated_at: take the Stripe updated_at from the Marketo↔Stripe match when present; otherwise from the Stripe↔Zendesk match; null when neither exists. - Zendesk updated_at: take the Zendesk updated_at from the Marketo↔Zendesk match when present; otherwise from the Stripe↔Zendesk match; null when neither exists. - Zendesk organization updated_at: take from the Marketo↔Zendesk match when present; otherwise from the Stripe↔Zendesk match; null when neither exists. - Overall created_at (named marketo_created_at): choose the earliest non-null among the Marketo, Stripe, and Zendesk created_at values available from the merged matches. - Stripe created_at: take the Stripe created_at from the Marketo↔Stripe match when present; otherwise from the Stripe↔Zendesk match; null when neither exists. - Zendesk created_at: take the Zendesk created_at from the Marketo↔Zendesk match when present; otherwise from the Stripe↔Zendesk match; - name: customer360__address
      description: Consolidated customer addresses from Marketo and Stripe enriched with standardized country/state names and priority-based ranking
      grain: One row per sourced address per customer360_id (duplicates preserved)
      source_models:
      - marts.customer360__mapping
      - intermediate.int_customer360__marketo
      - intermediate.int_customer360__stripe
      - staging.stg_customer360__country_codes
      - staging.stg_customer360__state_territory_codes
      business_logic: '- Read pass-through datasets: - marts.customer360__mapping as mapping (provides marketo_lead_id and stripe_customer_id per customer360_id) - staging.stg_customer360__country_codes as country_codes - staging.stg_customer360__state_territory_codes as state_codes - Build Marketo addresses (inner join mapping.marketo_lead_id = int_customer360__marketo.lead_id): - Primary address: include rows where address_line_1 is not NULL; set source_system = "marketo", address_type = "primary", priority = 1; select address_line_1, address_line_2, city, state_code, country_code, postal_code - Billing address: include rows where billing_address_line_1 is not NULL; set source_system = "marketo", address_type = "billing", priority = 2; map billing_* fields to output columns - Build Stripe addresses (inner join mapping.stripe_customer_id = int_customer360__stripe.customer_id): - Customer address: include rows where customer_address_line_1 is not NULL; set source_system = "stripe", address_type = "customer", priority = 1; map customer_* fields - Shipping address: include rows where shipping_address_line_1 is not NULL; set source_system = "stripe", address_type = "shipping", priority = 2; map shipping_* fields - Union all Marketo and Stripe address rows; no de-duplication; only addresses with non-NULL address_line_1 are included. - Enrich with geographic names via left joins: - state: join state_codes on (state_code AND country_code) to derive state_territory; unmatched → NULL - country and country_alt_name: join country_codes on alpha-2 country code; unmatched → NULL - Compute rank: per customer360_id, assign row numbers ordered by priority ascending; within the same priority, order is unspecified and non-deterministic. - Output passes through source text as-is (casing/whitespace preserved); no normalization beyond the joins.'
      columns:
      - name: customer360_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer key from mapping used to group and rank addresses; multiple rows per customer360_id
      - name: source_system
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Origin system literal ('marketo' or 'stripe'); set per source and always non-null
      - name: address_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Address category set per source: Marketo → ''primary'' or ''billing''; Stripe → ''customer'' or ''shipping'''
      - name: address_line_1
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary address line; rows are included only when this is non-null; text is passed through without trimming or case changes
      - name: address_line_2
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Secondary address line from source; may be null; text is passed through without trimming or case changes
      - name: city
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: City from source; may be null; no transformation
      - name: state_code
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: State/province code from source used for state name enrichment; may be null; case preserved
      - name: state
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Resolved state/territory name from stg_customer360__state_territory_codes via (state_code,country_code) match; null if no match
      - name: country_code
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: ISO alpha-2 country code from source used for joins; may be null; case preserved
      - name: country
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Resolved country name from stg_customer360__country_codes via country_code_alpha_2; null if no match
      - name: country_alt_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Alternative country name from stg_customer360__country_codes; null if no match
      - name: postal_code
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Postal code from source stored as BIGINT; may be null; numeric-only storage means leading zeros are not preserved
      - name: priority
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Address priority set by source (1 for primary/customer, 2 for billing/shipping); lower number indicates higher priority
      - name: rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Row number per customer360_id ordered by priority ascending; ties within the same priority have arbitrary order
